summary: The letter urges the FCC to keep E‑Rate funding intact, argues that broadband equity remains essential for rural Title I schools, and rejects proposals to tie E‑Rate to screen‑time limits. The comment urges the FCC to preserve and strengthen the E‑Rate program, opposing sunset proposals and any narrowing of eligibility, and emphasizing the need for reliable broadband infrastructure for all students.
